needed.policy_yaml:
# Supervisor policy for agent customer_service - generated by the Onboarding Agent.
# Review every rule. Replace each FILL-ME-approver with two named approvers before
# merge. The agent starts in SHADOW: rules are evaluated and recorded, nothing is
# blocked until a rule is switched to enforced mode (see the launch report).
# Schema: policies/schema.json (supervisor.gateway.policy).
policy_version: 1
tools:
  lookup_customer: read_only
  open_dispute: money
  read_ticket: read_only
  reply: read_only
  waive_fee: money
agents:
  customer_service:
    name: Customer service agent
    owner_user: cc-lead@example.invalid
    owner_team: Retail Customer Care
    risk_tier: high
    model_family: qwen
    host_type: python_inprocess
    plug_point: gate_hook
    initial_state: SHADOW
rules:
- id: OB-CUSTOMER_SERVICE-01
  version: 1
  description: Customer service agent may call approved tools only
  agent_scope:
  - customer_service
  action: pause
  severity: critical
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: Decision 33 (banking) - approved tools
  owner: Retail Customer Care
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool:
      not_in:
      - lookup_customer
      - open_dispute
      - read_ticket
      - reply
      - waive_fee
- id: OB-CUSTOMER_SERVICE-02
  version: 1
  description: A money call must state amount_minor as a positive integer
  agent_scope:
  - customer_service
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: Internal payment control - complete instruction
  owner: Retail Customer Care
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool:
      in:
      - open_dispute
      - waive_fee
    any:
    - arg: amount_minor
      op: absent
    - arg: amount_minor
      op: le
      value: 0
- id: OB-CUSTOMER_SERVICE-03
  version: 1
  description: Single waive_fee limit 500000 (waive_fee_max_minor)
  agent_scope:
  - customer_service
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: Internal limit - single agent-initiated transaction
  owner: Retail Customer Care
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: waive_fee
    all:
    - arg: amount_minor
      op: gt
      value: 500000
- id: OB-CUSTOMER_SERVICE-04
  version: 1
  description: At most 2 open_dispute calls per customer_id per day
  agent_scope:
  - customer_service
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: AML structuring control - daily aggregate per customer
  owner: Retail Customer Care
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: open_dispute
  aggregate:
    window_s: 86400
    group_by: customer
    customer_arg: customer_id
    op: gt
    fn: count
    limit: 2
- id: OB-CUSTOMER_SERVICE-05
  version: 1
  description: At most 2 waive_fee calls per account_id per day
  agent_scope:
  - customer_service
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: AML structuring control - daily aggregate per customer
  owner: Retail Customer Care
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: waive_fee
  aggregate:
    window_s: 86400
    group_by: customer
    customer_arg: account_id
    op: gt
    fn: count
    limit: 2
